read.en: AMD rose 1.0% on Nov 4 to $488.78, trading between $476.50 and $514.61 on heavy volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($502.15), 10-day ($520.54) and 30-day ($572.84) and the rising 100-day ($528.92), and above the rising 200-day ($414.23). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and below zero, histogram slightly narrower; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($568.71), and RSI is 39.5.
read.zh: AMD 11月4日上涨 1.0%，收于 $488.78，盘中区间 $476.50–514.61，成交量放大。股价位于下行的 5 日（$502.15）、10 日（$520.54）和 30 日均线（$572.84）以及上行的 100 日均线（$528.92）下方，并高于上行的 200 日均线（$414.23）。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图略有收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$568.71），RSI 为 39.5。

read.en: The high of $514.61 pushed through the $492.2–502.6 resistance but the close fell back under it; the $466–476.5 lows held. Resistance is $492.2–502.6 (Oct 30 low, 5-day, Oct 22 low), then $512.8–520.5 (Nov 2, Nov 4 and Oct 30 highs, 10-day) and $528.9 (100-day). Support is $466.1–476.5 (Nov 2–4 lows), then $460.2–463.2 and $440.5–451. A close above $502.6 would target $513–521; below $466, $460–463.
